_about: Research verdicts and checkpoints shown on the dashboard's Research tab. Edit by hand (or ask Claude) when a verdict lands. verdict: GO | NO-GO | WEAK | PENDING | LIVE | INFO.
_paper_since_note: Paper is a blank slate for testing new strategies (Alex, Nov 7): the dashboard only shows paper orders placed after this time. Move it forward to start a fresh test.

bankroll_start._about: Start point for the dashboard's bankroll growth %. Deposits are not gains: add a deposit to amount. at = when this mode started trading.

favorites.label: Big-event favorites

weather_late.label: Late-day lows

weather.label: Weather day-before

events.title: Bot goes live: LOCK alerts + $37 test bankroll
events.summary: Scanner watches every Kalshi daily high/low market and pushes LOCK alerts when readings already decide a bracket.

events.title: Liquidity rewards
events.summary: Not worth it at our size, and the program ends Jan 1, 2027.

events.title: Bracket arb, gas, Polymarket arb, long-dated climate
events.summary: No usable edge in any of the four after fees.

events.title: Hourly temperature markets
events.summary: Market is well calibrated. Weak lead: fading 12-25c longshots 30-55 min out (+3c/contract, probably noise).

events.title: LOCK speed race
events.summary: About 30+ locked brackets per day, all already at $1.00 when first seen. Looks like a race we lose.

events.title: Monthly rain thresholds (census)
events.summary: Silent census every 15 min. Early: every passed threshold was already at $1.00.

events.title: Weather model backtest (full year)
events.summary: Day-before edge was profitable Jan-Aug 2026, about break-even Sep-Oct as the market caught up. Paper maker orders running.

events.title: NBM / MOS forecast inputs
events.summary: Better forecasts (NBM best single source) but no extra trading edge. The market already prices it.

events.title: Market-making bot on hourly temps
events.summary: Month replay about break-even; small plus in Miami/NYC, Chicago loses. Paper replay Nov 5-12.

events.title: Mentions longshot fade
events.summary: +4.2c per filled contract over 21 months (18 of 21 up). Running automatically on paper from Nov 5.

events.title: Economic data releases (CPI, PCE, GDP)
events.summary: Kalshi beats or matches the nowcasts; no lag edge. Three weak leads to re-test.

events.title: Longshot fade in Financials / Econ / Crypto
events.summary: One month showed +4.5c (Econ) and +6.8c (Financials). Full-history check running.

events.title: Longshots and favorites in every other category
events.summary: Only favorites at 85-96c in BIG events (1M+ contracts) pay, +3.7c per filled contract; small events lose. Running automatically on paper from Nov 5.

events.title: Newly launched markets
events.summary: Launch backtest running; new-market watcher logging in shadow.

events.title: Weather day-before back to paper
events.summary: Kalshi's prices now forecast tomorrow's temperature better than our models do (1.31F miss vs 1.60F), so the edge is gone. Real test lost $3.95 on 43 contracts. Re-check Jan-Feb.

events.title: Late-day lows
events.summary: After midday the market overpays for brackets below the low already recorded. Selling them backtests at +5.7c per contract (Oct 2025-Aug 2026) and +3.7c (Sep-Nov 2026), about 7 fills a day. Real money at 1 contract since Nov 11 (Alex's OK); reviews at 100/300/500 contracts.
